fund_name.quote: Ashgrove Special Situations Fund, L.P. (the "Partnership") is a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 19, 2023.

fund_domicile.quote: Ashgrove Special Situations Fund, L.P. (the "Partnership") is a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 19, 2023.

fund_structure.quote:
Interests may be redeemed as of the last business day of each calendar quarter.

The Partnership has a perpetual term and continues until dissolved by the General Partner or as otherwise provided in the Limited Partnership Agreement.

management_fee.value: 1.60% of the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account, determined prior to accrual of the Incentive Allocation
management_fee.quote: The Partnership pays the Investment Manager a management fee accrued monthly and payable quarterly in arrears at an annual rate of **1.60%** of the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account, determined prior to accrual of the Incentive Allocation. The Management Fee rate is identical for Class F and Class I Interests.

performance_fee.value: 20% of Net New Appreciation for Class I Interests; 15% of Net New Appreciation for Class F Interests
performance_fee.quote:
With respect to **Class I Interests**, the Incentive Allocation is **20% of Net New Appreciation**.

With respect to **Class F Interests**, the Incentive Allocation is **15% of Net New Appreciation**.

hurdle_rate.quote: As set forth in the original Memorandum, the Incentive Allocation is **not subject to any hurdle rate, preferred return or benchmark**, for either Class F or Class I Interests. Net New Appreciation is measured on an absolute basis.

high_water_mark.value: perpetual high water mark on a per-Limited-Partner, per-subscription basis
high_water_mark.quote: The Partnership maintains a **perpetual high water mark** on a per-Limited-Partner, per-subscription basis. "Net New Appreciation" means the increase in the value of a capital account for an Incentive Period in excess of the highest value of such capital account as of the close of any prior Incentive Period (the "High Water Mark"), adjusted for subscriptions and redemptions.

minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum initial subscription for Class I Interests is **$1,000,000**, and the minimum additional subscription is **$250,000**. The General Partner may waive either minimum in its sole discretion, subject to applicable investor eligibility requirements.

lockup_period.value: 18 months with a 2.00% early redemption charge
lockup_period.quote: Interests redeemed within **eighteen (18) months** of the date of the relevant subscription are subject to an early redemption charge of **2.00%** of the redemption proceeds, payable to the Partnership for the benefit of remaining Limited Partners.

redemption_frequency.quote: Interests may be redeemed as of the last business day of each calendar quarter.

redemption_notice_days.quote: Written notice of redemption must be received by the Administrator not less than **forty-five (45) calendar days** prior to the applicable redemption date.

gate_provision.value: fund-level gate of 25% of the Partnership's net asset value
gate_provision.citation: Appendix A, Supplement No. 1, Section S-2
gate_provision.quote:
The following limitations apply to redemptions from the Partnership as of any redemption date.

| Item | Limitation |
|---|---|
| Fund-level gate | 25% of the Partnership's net asset value as of the applicable redemption date |
| Investor-level gate | None. The Partnership applies a fund-level gate only. |
| Treatment of excess requests | Reduced pro rata; unsatisfied portion carried to the next redemption date with priority, subject to the gate then in effect |
| Maximum consecutive gated periods | Not limited |
| Initial payment of proceeds | Not less than 90% within 30 calendar days of the redemption date |
| Audit holdback | Balance paid within 30 calendar days following completion of the annual audit |
| Gate waiver | The General Partner may waive the gate in whole or in part in its sole discretion, including with respect to particular Limited Partners

key_man_provision.quote: Prospective investors should note that **the Partnership does not provide any key person provision, key man clause, or associated redemption right**. The departure, death, disability or incapacity of Mr. Brannigan-Tate, or of any other person, does not trigger any right of redemption, any suspension of the Partnership's activities, any notice obligation beyond that required by law, or any other remedy in favor of Limited Partners.

gp_commitment.quote: **The General Partner has not committed, and does not commit, to maintain any minimum investment in the Partnership.** There is no required general partner commitment, no stated minimum dollar amount, and no stated minimum percentage of net asset value.

fund_term.quote: The Partnership has a perpetual term and continues until dissolved by the General Partner or as otherwise provided in the Limited Partnership Agreement. There is no fixed termination date and no investment period.

auditor.quote: Effective for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, the Partnership has appointed **Wexley Sandoval Partners LLP** as its independent registered public accounting firm, replacing Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP.

administrator.quote: Kestrel Harbour Fund Administration, LLC serves as the Partnership's administrator, responsible for net asset value calculation, capital account maintenance, investor onboarding, and anti-money laundering procedures.

legal_counsel.quote: Farrow Tindall Greaves LLP serves as counsel to the Partnership, the General Partner and the Investment Manager. Counsel does not represent the Limited Partners.

mfn_election.quote: The Partnership does not offer a most favored nation election. Side letter terms are not disclosed to, and will not be offered to, other Limited Partners.
